request.amount_ada: 500,000,000 ada net change limit; no direct treasury withdrawal requested
request.deadline: Period begins at start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Record DRep agreement to a 500,000,000 ada cap on total Treasury withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Apply the cumulative-sum accounting method in lovelace and exclude Treasury inflows
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps only total lovelace removed from the Cardano Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals during the period and does not count Treasury inflows.
The proposed limit supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same Epochs 613-713 period.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit and remain valid.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer states that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but that practical room under it is becoming constrained.
The proposer states that increasing the limit to 500,000,000 ada preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals while keeping a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposer states that the action is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails.
The document references an IPFS copy of the enacted Cardano Constitution v2.4 as supporting constitutional context.

summary: The document is an Info action asking DReps to signal agreement to a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, replacing a prior 350,000,000 ada limit, with no direct withdrawal authorization.
